items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: "But we used to play our main song, all used to play it, Diddy Rambo. Do they play that yet?"

ctx.x: Yeah, oh I'll tell you. Do you remember playing Glory Land and sing on when you were playing sing on?

Oh yeah, yeah, we played that same amount of air. They ain't much distant to the customers. They ain't much distant to the customer playing than there was then, because it's the most of the same thing. But the honest thing, I never did follow a band after the funeral, you know, lately. But we used to play our main song, all used to play it, Diddy Rambo. Do they play that yet? They don't play that no more. You ever follow a band after the funeral?

Well, the Dukes of Calvonia, they buried a guy down from the Calvonia Club. And they did. But I'd say unless the guy is a real corner guy, you know, Tump, man, they wouldn't play it now anymore. I don't know why.
